chatHistory.content: Create a single continuous Remotion composition (3840x2160, 25fps, 666 total frames including closing black) for an Apify YouTube b-roll covering four Instagram Actors. Structure: TransitionSeries with fade() transitions between phases (17-frame fade overlap, linearTiming). DESIGN SYSTEM - Background: staticFile("assets/backgrounds/background_blue.png") as a full-canvas behind all content in every phase. - Safe zone wrapper: 250px from every edge (usable area 3340x1660 starting at 250,250). - Colors: bg #1A1A2E, navy #16213E, blue #00AAFF, green #4ADE80, amber #FBBF24, red #EF4444, muted #9CA3AF, white #FFFFFF, card rgba(255,255,255,0.05), cardBorder rgba(255,255,255,0.08) - Font: Inter throughout. Title pills: weight 800, 32px, blue, uppercase, letter- spacing 0.06em. Captions under titles: weight 500, 26px, muted. Body labels: weight 600-700, 22-30px. No text below 22px. - Motion: spring({ damping: 200 }) for all entrances. Stagger sequential elements by 12-15 frames. Use interpolate() with extrapolateLeft/Right "clamp" for all bounded animations. - Transitions: fade(), 17 frames, between every phase. ACTOR TITLE PILL (reused pattern across all four phases) - Blue accent card: rgba(0,170,255,0.08) fill, 2px solid rgba(0,170,255,0.3) border, border-radius 20px, padding 24px 48px. - Top line: Actor name (uppercase, blue, weight 800, 32px). - Bottom line: short caption (muted, weight 500, 26px). - Entrance: fade + translateY from -30px, spring damping 200, no scale. PHASE 1 — Instagram Profile Scraper (frames 0-175) Title pill "INSTAGRAM PROFILE SCRAPER" / caption "Full profile details + posts" at top center of safe zone, fades in frames 0-15. Layout (frames 0-175): - Left column (~1400px wide), profile mockup card: Card style: standard card fill/border, radius 28px, padding 48px. Top: 200px circular avatar placeholder (white at 0.12 opacity) + to the right two skeleton lines (username 60% width 22px tall, handle 40% width 16px tall). Stats row: three columns "Posts / Followers / Following" with skeleton numbers above muted labels, font 28px. Bio: two skeleton lines (80% and 65% width, 16px tall, opacity 0.15). 3x3 grid of square post tiles, gap 16px, each tile rgba(255,255,255,0.06) with a faint inner gradient and a tiny corner icon (alternate grid/reel SVG). - Right column (~1400px wide), extracted data container: Stack of 5 data pills appearing one by one. Each pill: rgba(0,170,255,0.12) fill, 1.5px blue border, radius 12px, padding 14px 28px, monospace 28px text in blue. Labels in order: "avatar", "username", "bio", "followers", "posts[]". Container has a thin dashed border with label "EXTRACTED DATA" above (muted, 22px, letter-spacing 0.15em, uppercase). - Scanner bar: full-width horizontal blue gradient bar (rgba(0,170,255,0.18) center, transparent edges), height 100px, 1.5px top/bottom blue lines. Sweeps from y=0 to y=(card height) over frames 30-90 using interpolate. Timing within phase: - 0-15: title pill enters - 10-30: profile card slides in from x=-80 - 30-90: scanner bar sweeps top-to-bottom across the profile card - Each data pill entrance staggered: pill 1 at frame 50, pill 2 at 62, pill 3 at 74, pill 4 at 86, pill 5 at 98. Each pill: opacity 0->1, translateX from +60 to 0, scale 0.7 -> 1, spring damping 200. - 110-175: hold; data container has a subtle box-shadow pulse using Math.sin(frame * 0.12) * 0.4 + 0.6 for glow intensity (max 40px blue glow). PHASE 2 — Instagram Hashtag Scraper (frames 175-357, phase-local 0-182) Title pill "INSTAGRAM HASHTAG SCRAPER" / caption "Reels + posts behind any hashtag" at bottom center, fades in frames 130-150 of the phase. Layout (phase-local frames): - Top quarter: horizontal row of 5 hashtag pills, centered, gap 32px. Each pill: rgba(0,170,255,0.1) fill, 1.5px rgba(0,170,255,0.25) border, radius 40px, padding 16px 40px, blue text weight 700, 32px. Labels: "#travel", "#food", "#fitness", "#photography", "#design". - The "#travel" pill is highlighted from frame 30 onward: scale to 1.08, border becomes solid blue 2.5px, box-shadow glow 40px rgba(0,170,255,0.4), text color white. - A vertical connector line drops from #travel pill to the media grid below (drawn frame 35-50, 3px blue gradient line fading at the bottom). - Center-bottom: 2x3 media grid centered horizontally, tile size ~520x780 (9:16), gap 32px. Top row (REELS): each tile has a dark navy gradient fill, centered white play triangle SVG (60x60), top-left "REEL" tag (rgba(0,0,0,0.5) chip, white text 20px weight 700), bottom skeleton line (60% width, 14px tall, opacity 0.2). Bottom row (POSTS): each tile has a flat blue-tinted gradient fill, top-left "POST" tag (same chip style), no play icon, bottom skeleton line. Each tile: 1.5px border rgba(255,255,255,0.08), radius 18px. Timing within phase: - 0-25: 5 hashtag pills enter staggered, each delayed by 12 frames. Entrance: opacity 0->1, translateX from -30, scale 0.7->1. - 30-55: #travel pill scale-up + glow ramp-in (spring damping 200 on the scale, glow interpolated from 0 to 40px). - 35-50: connector line draws, width 3px, height interpolated 0 -> full. - 55-100: media grid tiles fade in staggered. Order: reel 1 at 55, reel 2 at 67, reel 3 at 79, post 1 at 91, post 2 at 103, post 3 at 115. Each: opacity 0->1, translateY from +40, scale 0.85->1, spring damping 200. - 130-150: title pill enters at bottom (translateY from +30). - 150-182: hold; #travel pill glow pulses subtly (sin wave, 0.5 amplitude). PHASE 3 — Related Hashtag Scraper (frames 357-510, phase-local 0-153) Title pill "RELATED HASHTAG SCRAPER" / caption "Go deeper · recent or top posts" at top center, fades in 0-15. Layout (phase-local frames): - Center: large #travel pill, scale ~1.4x the related-hashtag pills, same style as Phase 2 highlighted pill (blue glow, solid border, white text 40px weight 800). Position at center of safe zone. - Five thin blue connector lines (2.5px, rgba(0,170,255,0.5)) radiate from the edge of #travel pill to five surrounding positions: top-left (-700, -350 from center) top-right (+700, -350) middle-left (-900, +20) middle-right (+900, +20) bottom (+0, +450) Each line drawn using interpolate on a length value; use SVG elements with stroke-dasharray to animate the draw, or a width-interpolated div with rotation. - At the end of each line, a smaller related-hashtag pill (style: standard hashtag pill from Phase 2, normal size 28px text). Labels in line order above: "#wanderlust", "#adventure", "#vacation", "#explore", "#travelgram". - Below the bottom three related-hashtag pills (middle-right, bottom, top-right positions — pick whichever 3 are visually balanced), a small cluster of 4 mini post thumbnails: 160x160 squares, radius 12px, alternating fills (2 dark navy, 2 blue-tinted), each with a tiny chip in the corner — green "RECENT" or amber "★ TOP", chip size 14px text, padding 4px 10px. - Top-right corner of safe zone: two filter badges stacked vertically: "Recent ↻" — green pill (rgba(74,222,128,0.12) fill, 1.5px green border, 26px green text weight 700) "★ Top" — amber pill (rgba(251,191,36,0.12) fill, 1.5px amber border, 26px amber text weight 700) Both visible from frame 100 onward. Timing within phase: - 0-15: title pill enters at top - 15-35: center #travel pill scales in (scale 0.6->1, spring damping 200, fade) - 35-75: connector lines draw outward, staggered by 8 frames each (line 1 at frame 35, line 2 at 43, ... line 5 at 67). Each line: length interpolates 0 to target over 25 frames. - 45-95: related-hashtag pills appear at the line endpoints, staggered to follow each line's completion (pill 1 at frame 60, pill 2 at 68, pill 3 at 76, pill 4 at 84, pill 5 at 92). Each: opacity 0->1, scale 0.5->1, spring damping 200. - 95-130: mini post thumbnails fade in staggered (4 thumbs, 8 frames apart). Each: opacity 0->1, translateY from +20. - 100-115: filter badges fade in from right (translateX from +40). - 115-153: filter badges pulse alternately — Recent green glow on even sin cycles, Top amber glow on odd, using Math.sin(frame * 0.1). PHASE 4 — Instagram Scraper for locations (frames 510-646, phase-local 0-136) Title pill "INSTAGRAM SCRAPER" / caption "Tagged locations + post details" at bottom center, fades in 0-15. Layout (phase-local frames): - Left two-thirds of safe zone (~2200px wide): map container. Background: staticFile("assets/other/world.svg") rendered with filter "invert(1) sepia(1) saturate(2) hue-rotate(180deg)", opacity 0.4, objectFit contain, centered. Radial blue glow overlay at center: linear-gradient radial rgba(0,170,255,0.06) to transparent. Three location pins placed at approximate positions: Pin 1 "Brooklyn Bridge" at (25%, 45%) Pin 2 "Eiffel Tower" at (52%, 38%) — SELECTED Pin 3 "Tokyo Tower" at (78%, 47%) Each pin: blue dot 48px diameter with 5px rgba(0,170,255,0.4) outer ring, box-shadow glow 36px rgba(0,170,255,0.7), 4px stem 32px tall below. Pin label floats above each pin: small dark navy chip (rgba(22,33,62,0.9) fill, 1.5px rgba(0,170,255,0.3) border, radius 12px, padding 10px 20px, white text 24px weight 700). Selected pin (Eiffel Tower): 1.2x scale, brighter glow (60px shadow), label chip border is solid blue 2px. - Right third (~1100px wide): detail card for selected location. Standard card style, radius 28px, padding 44px. Header: "Eiffel Tower, Paris" (blue, weight 800, 36px, letter-spacing 0.04em). Sub-line: "Tagged posts · 12,847" (muted, 26px weight 600), with small location-pin SVG icon (24px, blue) to the left. Below: 2x2 grid of post thumbnails, 200x200 each, gap 16px. Each tile: dark navy gradient fill, 1.5px border rgba(255,255,255,0.08), radius 14px, with a small location-pin SVG icon (20px, white at 0.7 opacity) in the bottom-right corner. Beneath the grid: two skeleton lines (75% and 55% width, 14px tall, opacity 0.15) suggesting caption metadata. Timing within phase: - 0-15: title pill enters at bottom - 5-25: map background fades in (opacity 0 -> 0.4) - 25-60: three pins drop in staggered (pin 1 at frame 25, pin 2 at 37, pin 3 at 49). Each: opacity 0->1, translateY from -30, scale 0->1, spring damping 200. - 55-75: Eiffel Tower pin scale-up to 1.2x + brighter glow ramp-in - 60-95: detail card slides in from right (translateX from +80, opacity 0->1, spring damping 200) - 80-115: 2x2 thumbnail grid tiles fade in staggered (4 tiles, 8 frames apart) - 90-110: pin labels fade in above each pin (translateY from +10, opacity 0->1) - 115-136: hold; selected pin glow pulses (sin wave, subtle 0.3 amplitude) CLOSING BLACK (frames 646-666) Pure #000000 AbsoluteFill for 20 frames. COMPOSITION ASSEMBLY Use TransitionSeries with these sequence durations (each phase content + 17-frame transition overlap added per the existing project pattern): - Phase 1: 175 + 17 frames - fade transition: 17 frames - Phase 2: 182 + 17 frames - fade transition: 17 frames - Phase 3: 153 + 17 frames - fade transition: 17 frames - Phase 4: 136 + 17 frames - fade transition: 17 frames - BlackScreen: 20 frames Each Phase component uses useCurrentFrame() (phase-local frames starting at 0) and useVideoConfig() for fps. All entrance animations use spring() with damping 200. All bounded interpolations use extrapolateLeft "clamp", extrapolateRight "clamp". Wrap every phase's content in a SafeZone div (absolute position, left 250, top 250, width 3340, height 1660, overflow hidden) over the Background .
